thread:
sanjay: Quick idea — run a tiny "High‑Five Sticker Station" + pop-up micro coffee cart next Wed (10/11) 11:30–13:00 in the SF HQ kitchen to hand out spot-award cards and do casual kudos. Who can help run?

anya: love this. do we have budget for the cart + stickers? :coffee: :star2:

people-ops: We can cover up to $400 for a pop-up per headcount cap for micro events. Need an itemized estimate and an event owner for receipts. I'll post the vendor list.

sanjay: vendor idea — TinyBrew micro-cart (I've used them) $275 + optional tip. Stickers from StickerSprint ~ $45. Total ~ $320. I'll submit if folks sign off.

people-ops-bot: /reminder set "Confirm micro-cart & stickers" for @sanjay tomorrow 09:30

maria: I can pick up the sticker order on Monday and bring the laminator for the spot-award cards.

omar: I have a stash of those metallic high-five stickers we used last hackweek — I'll bring them. Also can cover shift 12:00–12:30.

jules: I can help steward the session 11:30–12:00. Will take photos for #random.

anya: heads-up — quick policy Q: are spot-award gift cards taxable and do we need to run them through payroll? want to mention in the invite.

people-ops: Good question. Short answer: small non-cash items and nominal awards are subject to payroll reporting in many cases. We'll confirm with payroll, but plan to track award recipients and approximate value. If we cross $100 per person we'll run via one-time payroll report. I'll follow up by EOD.

sanjay: thanks — that's fine. will label each card with 'spot-award $25' so we have a record.

people-ops: Awesome. Next steps:
1) sanjay submit vendor invoice to people-ops (attach to #expenses).
2) maria bring laminator + template (see snippet).
3) omar/jules cover shifts.
4) people-ops to confirm payroll treatment and confirm budget.

people-ops: RSVP link: https://forms.company/mini-popups (please RSVP so we know volumes)

sanjay: submitted invoice in #expenses just now.

people-ops-bot: spot-awards-bot: Reminder: use `/spot-award @someone <reason>` to log nominations during the event. Rewards will be tallied for reporting.

maria: sample card template below — can we put the QR to the nomination form on the back?
```
Spot Award: $25
Recipient: __________________
Reason (1–2 lines): __________________
Nominee: __________________
```

omar: QR on back works. i'll bring the sticker sheet holder and a card tray.

anya: ok, I think this is green. people-ops, once payroll confirms, can we get a short blurb for the invite about tax/reporting? want to be transparent.

people-ops: Yes — will post a 2‑sentence blurb once payroll chimes in. For now we can say: "Small awards will be tracked and reported per company policy. Gifts may be subject to payroll reporting."

jules: last check — power outlet near the kitchen island enough for the cart?

sanjay: yep — TinyBrew needs one outlet. I'll include that in the vendor notes.

people-ops: Perfect. Thanks everyone — I'll confirm payroll by 5pm and post the final invite. :party-popper:

sanjay: thanks all! see you Wed. :raised_hands:
